svg.title: About me
svg.desc: About me. Shaping The Future Of Ai-Powered Creation. I am an AI Engineer pursuing my MSCS at UC San Diego, bridging theoretical research and scalable, real-world systems. My focus sits where computer vision meets agentic AI. With a foundation from OUTR (B.Tech), I have built intelligent pipelines for hard problems, from cancer-risk assessment via spatial transcriptomics to agentic automation of pre-silicon chip design. Right now I am building agents that act on real systems and can show their work: a cited legal-case digest, vision-grounded reasoning over scene graphs, and human-approved browser automation. Coder, artist, traveler. MSCS at UC San Diego.
